name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Please make sure to bring 1 Valentine's card for all 22 friends in the class and to leave the "To" section of the card blank for easier pass out! Our bags were unexpectedly on the smaller side this year, so please keep goodies and prizes small this year!

name: Father/Daughter Dance
description: Get excited!! The theme of this year's dances is: Denim and Diamonds! So bust out your best denim, bling, and/or western attire and dance the night away!

name: Spirit Day: Wear a Sports Shirt
description: PARENTS: Wear a sports-themed shirt

name: Label New Items
description: PARENTS: Over the holidays, the kids have definitely grown! Many of them came to school with new sweaters, clothes, and jackets! Please make sure to label these new items with their name for easier reunification! Many kids have been coming to school this week with gloves! Please make sure they can identify them if they brought them! I currently have two sets at school and no one knows who they belong to!

name: Galentine's Night Out at F45 Branham Park
description: 45 minutes of strength training work out followed by bubbles. Each F45 workout is a unique program that incorporates cardio, resistance- based strength training, or a hybrid of both, all geared toward everyday life. No two workouts are the same, keeping members challenged and having fun. All of the F45 coaches are certified personal trainers who have the skills to safely modify each movement to any member's individual needs. Our goal is to help you become your fittest, strongest and healthiest self!

name: Family Fun Night- Five Guys
description: Mention Los Alamitos and 25% of proceeds will be donated to the PTA!!

name: Variety Show - Audition Videos Due
description: Audition Videos Due for the Variety Show. Do you have a talent to share? Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: Yearbook 5th Grade Baby Photos Due
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 1st!

name: Middle School Selection Process
description: Families will submit school choice requests online through the School Choice section of Parent Portal, which will be open from January 20 through February 13, 2026. An active Parent Portal account is required.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday).

name: Yearbook Orders
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.
